$schema: Ship list rendered on dummy-labs.com. Routines append entries here when SHIPPED=true. Status values: 'live' (deployed + payment-functional + public URL) | 'scaffolded' (code complete, deploy pending) | 'iterating' (post-launch improvements in flight) | 'dead' (killed). Optional 'color' field is the hex of the ship's brand accent (see daily-ship/docs/playbooks/design-system.md) — used by the landing page card to give each ship its own identity.

ships.name: AIBudget
ships.tagline: AI tool cost calculator for engineering teams
ships.description: Pick from 31 AI tools across 4 categories, set seat counts and usage tiers (light/standard/heavy), get a live monthly burn-rate forecast. Built for finance + eng leads who got burned by GitHub Copilot's June 1 usage-based billing switch. Email-gated PDF export.

ships.name: VibeScan
ships.description: Paste any AI-generated code and get an instant security audit. Finds real vulnerabilities — SQL injection, XSS, exposed credentials, insecure APIs — before they reach production. Built for teams shipping with AI speed.

ships.name: SecretScan
ships.tagline: Find hardcoded secrets in AI-generated code
ships.description: 60+ regex patterns + Shannon entropy analysis catch leaked API keys, tokens, and credentials. Runs 100% in your browser — your code never leaves the page.

ships.name: SlopsquatGuard
ships.tagline: Catch AI-hallucinated npm packages before install
ships.description: Scans your package.json against the live npm registry to catch slopsquatting — the attack vector exploiting LLMs that hallucinate non-existent package names. 19.7% of LLM-generated dependencies don't exist; some attackers pre-register those names with malware.

ships.name: DepShield
ships.description: Catches typosquatted dependencies, deprecated packages, and supply-chain anomalies before they enter your dependency tree. Levenshtein-distance scoring against the top 300 npm packages.

ships.name: AgentRoster
ships.tagline: Know every AI agent running in your company before your boss asks.
ships.description: AI agent registry dashboard for IT managers and CTOs. Add your agents (name/owner/cost/data access), get auto risk scores, see total AI spend, download audit PDF. Built for the post-Microsoft-Agent-365 wave of <200-person companies that need governance without enterprise tooling.

ships.name: EnvGuard
ships.tagline: Audit your .env file for real secrets, placeholders, and service ownership.
ships.description: Paste a .env file, get entropy analysis to separate real secrets from placeholders, plus per-line service identification (50+ services across AI/LLM, payments, cloud, auth, email, monitoring). 100% client-side — your secrets never leave the page. Email-gated PDF report on real-secret detection.
